entities.name: Jean-Michel Huon de Kermadec
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Michel Huon de Kermadec was a French Navy officer. He took part in voyages of exploration in the Pacific Ocean under Bruni d'Entrecasteaux, looking for the lost expedition of Jean-François de La Pérouse.
